title: Accessibility Describe
description: An accessibility-focused image analysis node that generates scene descriptions
optimized for blind and visually impaired users. Powered by Google Gemini Vision,
it provides structured descriptions including spatial layout (clock positions),
hazard detection, text reading (OCR), people detection, and navigation guidance.
Designed for real-time assistive technology applications like smart glasses.

model.title: Vision Model
model.description: Select the Gemini vision model for accessibility descriptions

systemPrompt.title: System Instructions
systemPrompt.description: Define the accessibility description behavior and priorities
systemPrompt.default: You are an accessibility-focused scene analyzer designed to help blind and visually impaired users understand their surroundings through image descriptions.

prompt.title: Analysis Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt template for generating accessibility descriptions from images
prompt.default: Describe this image for a blind person. Include: environment type, hazards with positions, key objects with clock positions, visible text, people, and navigation guidance. Keep under 150 words.

prioritizeHazards.description: How aggressively to prioritize hazard detection
